all.title: All widgets · DevExtreme multi-calendar
all.lede: Every date widget on one page, in the calendar chosen at the top. Each editor shows its stored Gregorian value next to what the user sees; the grid, the scheduler and the pivot grid follow the same calendar.
all.card.dateBoxDatetimeMask: DateBox — date and time, typed input (mask)
all.card.dataGrid: DataGrid — date column with display format and edit form
all.card.scheduler: Scheduler — day and week headers in the selected calendar
all.card.pivotGrid: PivotGrid — dates grouped by calendar year and month, stored as Gregorian
